title: Canada-U.S. Trade War Escalates as Talks Collapse
summary: Intense negotiations to stave off new levies by the Trump administration ended in an impasse as Mark Carney suspended talks. U.S. tariffs on Canada, and retaliatory tariffs on the U.S., will come into effect.

summary: The move prompted blowback from cattle ranchers and Republicans who represent them.

title: Pentagon Fires Editor and Publisher of Independent Military Publication
summary: The firings at Stars and Stripes also claimed a Middle East correspondent. They are the latest effort by the Pentagon to diminish the news outlet’s editorial independence.

title: Trump Threatens Defamation Suit Over National Guard Report, Aiming to Intimidate a Critic
summary: It was the latest example of President Trump’s bid to use the legal system against those who voice unflattering facts and opinions generally protected by the First Amendment.

summary: The ruling from the Southern District of New York found that the policy went beyond Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s legal authority.

title: U.S. Cuts Colorado River Water for Arizona, California and Nevada
summary: Arizona’s share of the river will shrink by a third, likely increasing reliance on groundwater and raising pressure on agriculture.

title: Meghan of Sussex Eyes Role in Netflix Show ‘The Gentlemen’
summary: The duchess’s representatives have had exploratory talks about her joining a third season of “The Gentlemen,” two people said. Netflix has not yet ordered a third season of the show.

title: Prince Harry, Elton John and Others Told to Pay Daily Mail Publisher $13 Million
summary: Harry and six other high-profile figures lost a privacy lawsuit against Associated Newspapers. They may eventually have to pay more than twice the initial sum, a judge said.

summary: President Trump was in South Carolina to stump for Darline Graham, sister of Lindsey. But his own political future was on his mind, too.

summary: The plan complies with President Trump’s executive order to restrict mail voting, which was blocked by federal courts and is under review at the Supreme Court.

title: Desperation Mounts as Thousands in Indiana Endure 10 Days Without Power
summary: Floods from powerful thunderstorms devastated Gary, where a third of residents live below the poverty line and full restoration isn’t expected until next week.

summary: The Trump administration approved the payment after Liberia said it would consider taking migrants from other countries.

summary: At least five of the people flown to Liberia under the Trump administration’s third-country deportation program resisted leaving the plane. They were then flown to Equatorial Guinea.

summary: The Justice Department resolved a lawsuit that accused the social media company of illegally gathering children’s information.

title: Rare South American Diseases Offer Clues on the Next Pandemic
summary: Ebola virus, hantavirus and the pathogen that causes Covid-19 likely jumped from animals to humans. So do these viruses — and scientists say climate change is speeding their spread.
